title: Outcome-Guided Auditing of Missing Treatment Labels for Capacity-Constrained Treatment Choice
banked_reason: D0.5.G graded incremental below the required field floor (paper-score ceiling 5.8 < 7.4); the numerical certificate and three panel findings were repaired and independently audited sound before banking.
gap_reasons: Even accepting the two-audit separation, the result remains a specialized exact-tie local experiment rather than a broadly usable audit-design characterization.

The analytic results establish Gaussian same-cost profiling and a local minimax equality only for the deliberately restricted class with deterministic audit-design limits, static main-wave auditing, an exact three-stratum tie, and known equal stratum masses.
paper_score_ceiling 5.8 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 derived the scoped common-chart local minimax transfer, same-cost Gaussian Blackwell audit profile, and a strict rational counterexample to trace-optimal auditing. After D0.5 halted below the field novelty floor, the full 127-box/64-leaf Arb certificate and independent strict-gap replay repaired the math-panel reproducibility finding; the theorem comparison and unused proposition findings were also repaired. Independent bounded soundness audits passed, but the known-mass exact-tie static-audit result remains below the field-level generality requested; no Lean formalization was started.
tldr: When outcomes are observed but historical treatment labels are missing, the labels worth recovering depend on the downstream capacity decision. Kennedy's fixed-mechanism MAR covariance is an input, not a contribution. At each fixed cost vector, the clipped square-root audit Blackwell dominates every same-cost audit in the Gaussian limit experiment through an explicit parameter-free independent-noise kernel; it therefore cannot increase the risk of any decision problem on the Gaussian local parameter, and the capacity-regret specialization reduces to a compact budget triangle. For the rational interior witness at \(H=1/10\) and \(B=1\), a feasible rational audit is certified within \(0.000002482089725\) of the globally optimal normalized regret, while the exact trace-variance-optimal audit has normalized regret penalty greater than \(0.00029139985935\). The all-procedure local minimax equality is proved for all procedures in \(\mathfrak A\), including prespecified audits and the stated negligible-pilot selectors; no larger procedure class is claimed.
gap: Kennedy's missing-treatment efficiency theory supplies the canonical gradient for a given label-observation mechanism, capacity-constrained treatment-choice theory treats the experiment as given, and fixed-covariance Gaussian regret theory does not determine which existing labels should be recovered. Precision-optimal two-phase designs therefore do not answer the coupled capacity-regret question or its uniform pilot-selected experiment transfer.
fill: The project uses the published MAR covariance as an input, profiles the audit-feasible covariance family inside the capacity-regret objective, derives the fixed-audit local minimax game in an explicit fixed-\(P_X\) chart, and poses the uniform all-procedure equality under an explicit external-pilot/main law. Its theorem-level audit contribution is the rational equal-budget full-cube separation from the unique trace optimum together with a finite global interval certificate; its unresolved transfer contribution is uniformity over the continuum of audit kernels, including pilot-selected designs and closed audit faces.
